title: TrackerBundleError
responsibility: Identifies an installer failure and formats its diagnostic for the Tracker install log.

inputs.name: TrackerBundleError.describe.error
inputs.description: Value caught while installing or restoring the Tracker service.
inputs.unknownReason: JavaScript can throw a value of any type. The formatter checks its type before reading error details.

outputs.name: TrackerBundleError.describe
outputs.description: Installer diagnostic, runtime error identifier, or a generic message when the thrown value is unrecognized.
